purpose: Map UPI against arXiv and adjacent scholarly/research-data infrastructure.

evidence_rule.source: A source can document a claim or provide a research object.
evidence_rule.metadata: Metadata can establish identity, provenance and relationships.
evidence_rule.infrastructure: Networks and catalogues can transport/discover data.
evidence_rule.validation: Scientific validation requires claim-specific evidence and independent verification.

mapping_to_upi.DER: mathematical or logical consequence explicitly derived from accepted premises
mapping_to_upi.HYP: UPI interpretation not established by the source
mapping_to_upi.STOP: missing measurable quantity, inverse map, domain or evidence

current_physics_boundary.E_equals_hf: EST in the defined quantum/spectroscopic domain when sourced to appropriate experimental literature.
current_physics_boundary.m_equals_E_over_c2: DER/EST depending exact formulation and domain.
current_physics_boundary.mI_equals_hf_over_c2: HYP as UPI information-mass interpretation; algebraically follows from E=hf and m=E/c2 but does not establish a new observable.
current_physics_boundary.eight_hz_universal_constant: STOP unless independently measured/defined for a specific physical system.
current_physics_boundary.eleven_d_brane_to_upi_resonance: SYM/STOP until a measurable quantity and invertible mapping are supplied.

audit_scope: Source registry and architecture mapping. It does not claim that every paper in each service has been reviewed.
